attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kansas military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per KSA § 79-32,117 (2025). NEEDS AUTHORSHIP: skeleton table — conditions, actions, and exclusion logic not yet implemented.

Calculates Kansas state income tax per Form K-40. Kansas uses progressive tax brackets: 5.20% on first bracket, 5.58% above threshold. Senate Bill 1 (2024) consolidated three brackets into two. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction and personal exemptions based on filing status, then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_dsl: add "KANSAS FORM K-40 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail; set result.ks_agi = result.agi; set result.ks_bracket_1_tax = 0; set result.ks_bracket_2_tax = 0
initial_action.action_postfix: "KANSAS FORM K-40 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.ks_agi xdef 0 /result.ks_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.ks_bracket_2_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate KS tax MFJ; Calculate KS tax with MFJ standard deduction, personal exemptions, and progressive brackets. HARD: 2-tier progressive bracket math (5.20%/5.58% above $46,000 MFJ threshold) — same situation as #496 Part 2; bracket cumulative cascade left for follow-up authorship. Postfix is authoritative for now.
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.ks_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto ks_standard_deduction_mfj /result.ks_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.ks_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto ks_personal_exemption_mfj job.dependents length ks_dependent_exemption i* i+ /result.ks_personal_exemption_total xdef " Personal Exemptions ($18,320 + $" ks_dependent_exemption cvs strconcat " * " strconcat job.dependents length cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.ks_personal_exemption_total cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ks_agi result.ks_standard_deduction f- result.ks_personal_exemption_total i2f f- 0 fmax /result.ks_taxable_income xdef " KS Taxable Income: $" result.ks_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction - Exemptions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ks_taxable_income ks_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f> if ks_bracket_2_threshold_mfj ks_bracket_1_rate f* /result.ks_bracket_1_tax xdef result.ks_taxable_income ks_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- ks_bracket_2_rate f* /result.ks_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (5.20% on $0-$46,000): $" result.ks_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (5.58% above $46,000): $" result.ks_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.ks_taxable_income ks_bracket_1_rate f* /result.ks_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (5.20% on $0-$" result.ks_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.ks_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif result.ks_bracket_1_tax result.ks_bracket_2_tax f+ /result.ks_tax xdef " Total KS Tax: $" result.ks_tax cvs strconcat " (Form K-40)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
